TDPOWERSYS.name: TD Power Systems
TDPOWERSYS.summary: The stock is 10% below its high, a shallow pullback within a strong uptrend.
TDPOWERSYS.why: Guidance raised, shallow pullback. Check for a fundraise.

points.text: The stock is 10% below its high, a shallow pullback within a strong uptrend.
Q1 FY27 revenue rose about 72% YoY.
It raised its FY27 revenue guidance to ₹2,600 crore.
A board meeting on 14 Aug was set to consider raising funds, so check whether a dilutive QIP is pending.
Valuation is stretched (P/E around 70).

AEROFLEX.name: Aeroflex Industries
AEROFLEX.summary: Q1 FY27 revenue grew 72.4% and PAT rose 162%.
AEROFLEX.why: Strong growth, expensive, volatile, thin liquidity

points.text: Q1 FY27 revenue grew 72.4% and PAT rose 162%.
Liquid-cooling skid capacity was raised 50%, with further expansion planned.
P/E is about 102, volatility is the highest of the ten (67%), and liquidity is thin (₹53 cr/day).
That makes it the most fragile in a falling market.

ATHERENERG.name: Ather Energy
ATHERENERG.summary: Q1 revenue grew 89% and the loss narrowed 71%.
ATHERENERG.why: Strong catalysts and brokers, but still pulling back

points.text: Q1 revenue grew 89% and the loss narrowed 71%.
It was also added to the MSCI India Domestic Small Cap Index.
Hero MotoCorp is lifting its stake to about 32.8%.
A global broker raised its target to ₹1,926.
The stock has slid about 16% from its early-September high, so the story is intact but the price is digesting a big run.
High oil prices are a tailwind for the EV theme.

RRKABEL.name: RR Kabel
RRKABEL.summary: Q1 PAT jumped 129% and EBITDA doubled.

points.text: Q1 PAT jumped 129% and EBITDA doubled.
CLSA initiated at Outperform with a ₹2,850 target.
The stock is 16% off its high, so it is consolidating.
Volatility is moderate (44%), which is better than most here.

E2E.name: E2E Networks
E2E.summary: Q1 revenue was ₹156.76 crore vs ₹36.11 crore a year earlier, with a profit of ₹43.88 crore, on GPU cluster expansion.

points.text: Q1 revenue was ₹156.76 crore vs ₹36.11 crore a year earlier, with a profit of ₹43.88 crore, on GPU cluster expansion.
P/E is about 398 and the stock fell 11.8% in the month to 18 Sep.
It has bounced since.
It is an AI-theme stock with thin liquidity and gap risk in both directions.

ACUTAAS.name: Acutaas Chemicals
ACUTAAS.summary: It received PLI approval for an electrolyte additives plan and commissioned a high-potency API pilot plant.

points.text: It received PLI approval for an electrolyte additives plan and commissioned a high-potency API pilot plant.
Quarterly revenue and profit were lower sequentially (₹327 cr and ₹76 cr in Jun vs ₹436 cr and ₹137 cr in Mar).
The 6-1 return is negative.
The price has moved sideways since June.
There is no clear trigger for a 21-day move.

DIACABS.name: Diamond Power Infra
DIACABS.summary: It hit a 52-week high of about ₹395 on 17 Sep, up 202% in six months, with a P/E near 128.

points.text: It hit a 52-week high of about ₹395 on 17 Sep, up 202% in six months, with a P/E near 128.
Book value per share was negative in the July data.
It is now 14% off that high.
The T&D order-book story is real, but the valuation and balance sheet make it a momentum-only trade.

KIRLOSENG.name: Kirloskar Oil Engines
KIRLOSENG.summary: June-quarter revenue was ₹1,482 cr vs ₹1,284 cr a year ago, but EBITDA slipped to ₹176 cr from ₹184 cr, so margins are compressing.

points.text: June-quarter revenue was ₹1,482 cr vs ₹1,284 cr a year ago, but EBITDA slipped to ₹176 cr from ₹184 cr, so margins are compressing.
The 6-1 return is −11% and the stock is 16.5% below its high.
Momentum is fading.

THANGAMAYL.name: Thangamayil Jewellery
THANGAMAYL.summary: It hit a high of ₹7,429 and traded near ₹5,085 on 22 Sep.

points.text: It hit a high of ₹7,429 and traded near ₹5,085 on 22 Sep.
It is now about 31% below the peak.
Q1 EBITDA (₹145 cr) fell from ₹214 cr in the March quarter.
It has the weakest chart in the batch: a clear downtrend, a negative 6-1 return, and a gold-price-sensitive business.

LAURUSLABS.name: Laurus Labs
LAURUSLABS.summary: Its close is only 1.1% below its 12-month high, and its volatility is the lowest of the ten (28%).
LAURUSLABS.why: Relative strength near highs, lowest volatility, defensive sector

points.text: Its close is only 1.1% below its 12-month high, and its volatility is the lowest of the ten (28%).
FY26 profit after tax was ₹740 crore vs ₹380 crore the year before.
It is up about 94% in six months and holding near highs while the index falls.
Pharma is also defensive in a risk-off tape.
P/E is high, so it can still pull back.
